verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS verification platform with a Dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a no-code workflow editor, Dashboard overrides and risk displays, but nothing about an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server is an external integration surface for outside agents, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
